# AudioTools.dev

> AudioTools.dev: free, MIT-licensed audio processing tools that run entirely in your browser. No uploads, no sign-up, no usage limits, and the source code is public so the no-upload claim can be verified. All processing uses Web Audio API and WebAssembly.

## Online Tools

- [Audio Converter](https://audiotools.dev/converter/): Convert audio (WAV, FLAC, OGG, AAC, M4A, WebM) or the soundtrack of a video (MP4, MOV, MKV) to MP3, M4A, WAV or FLAC. Streams large files; converts several files at once with a ZIP download. Built on Mediabunny. No file upload.
- [Voice to Text](https://audiotools.dev/voice-to-text/): Live dictation in 60+ languages (Web Speech Recognition API), plus Private mode: transcribe audio files and recordings with Whisper running on-device (Transformers.js) — audio never leaves the browser.
- [Text to Speech](https://audiotools.dev/text-to-speech/): Convert text to natural speech in 50+ languages. Adjustable speed (0.25x-3x), pitch, volume.
- [Audio Trimmer](https://audiotools.dev/audio-trimmer/): Cut audio files with visual waveform editor. Drag handles, preview, download WAV.
- [Audio Joiner](https://audiotools.dev/audio-joiner/): Merge multiple audio files into one with crossfade transitions. Drag to reorder.
- [Volume Booster](https://audiotools.dev/volume-booster/): Increase audio volume up to 500% or normalize to consistent peak level. Soft-clipping.
- [Audio Speed Changer](https://audiotools.dev/audio-speed-changer/): Slow down or speed up audio. 0.25x to 4x with pitch preservation.
- [Audio Compressor](https://audiotools.dev/audio-compressor/): Reduce audio file size by adjusting bitrate and sample rate, one file or a whole batch (ZIP download).

## Open Source Projects (GitHub)

- [go-audio-converter](https://github.com/formeo/go-audio-converter): Pure Go audio converter — no FFmpeg, no CGO. Custom FLAC encoder. Single binary.
- [voice-to-text](https://github.com/formeo/voice-to-text): Bulk voice message transcription. Whisper, faster-whisper, OpenAI API, Groq. Telegram bot included.
- [music_recognition](https://github.com/formeo/music_recognition): Bulk music identification via Shazam API. Auto ID3 tagging, file renaming.
- [audiobook-cleaner](https://github.com/formeo/Audiobook-Cleaner): AI audiobook noise removal using MDX-Net, VR, and Roformer models.

## About

- [About AudioTools.dev](https://audiotools.dev/about/): who builds it, how files stay on the device (and how to verify it in DevTools), what the site loads from the network, and how it is built.
- [Changelog](https://audiotools.dev/changelog/): dated list of everything that has shipped since January 2026.
- Format pages (the converter with the target format preselected): [MP4 to MP3](https://audiotools.dev/mp4-to-mp3/), [Video to MP3](https://audiotools.dev/video-to-mp3/) (MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM), [MP3 to WAV](https://audiotools.dev/mp3-to-wav/), [WAV to MP3](https://audiotools.dev/wav-to-mp3/). Chinese: /zh/mp4-to-mp3/, /zh/video-to-mp3/, /zh/mp3-to-wav/, /zh/wav-to-mp3/.
- Chinese versions: [homepage](https://audiotools.dev/zh/), [audio converter](https://audiotools.dev/zh/converter/), [volume booster](https://audiotools.dev/zh/volume-booster/), [text to speech](https://audiotools.dev/zh/text-to-speech/), [audio joiner](https://audiotools.dev/zh/audio-joiner/), [audio compressor](https://audiotools.dev/zh/audio-compressor/), [audio trimmer](https://audiotools.dev/zh/audio-trimmer/), [speed changer](https://audiotools.dev/zh/audio-speed-changer/), [voice to text](https://audiotools.dev/zh/voice-to-text/).

## Key Facts

- Privacy: all browser tools process audio locally. No files uploaded, audio is never collected. The site uses Google Analytics (and Yandex Metrika on Voice to Text) for anonymous page-view statistics only. Text to Speech uses the browser's voices; voices marked “online” are processed by the browser vendor.
- License: MIT.
- Formats: reads WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG, AAC, M4A, WebM and video (MP4, MOV, MKV); the converter saves MP3, M4A, WAV or FLAC, the other tools MP3 or WAV.
- Works offline: Converter, Trimmer, Joiner, Volume Booster, Speed Changer, Compressor work without internet.
- Mobile: all tools work on Chrome Android and Safari iOS.
- Author: Roman Gordienko (https://github.com/formeo)
- Sister site: DevToolKit.site — 21 free developer tools (JSON formatter, JWT decoder, PostgreSQL config generator)
